paths.description: Support landing page: primary product discovery and search entry point.
Windows section: representative product/category landing template.
Sign-in help article: representative long-form support content template.
Search results for wifi: representative primary search journey completion.
Unknown URL: representative HTTP failure and recovery state.

findings.summary: The site does not honor the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot remains white, and the computed probe reports color-scheme: normal with no dark surface retint.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark tokens using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Page and state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The CSS feature probe found no view-transition rules across the landing template, section, search, or article navigation surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for meaningful route/state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long pages provide static rather than scroll-state-aware navigation chrome.
findings.evidence: Landing and article captures show long documents while the feature probe found no scroll timeline/container behavior or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrained, reduced-motion-safe reading progress or scroll-state affordance on long support pages.

findings.summary: A sign-in teaching callout opens on load and obscures page content.
findings.evidence: Desktop landing and Windows section screenshots show a 260px sign-in callout covering the upper-right content before user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not auto-open the callout; expose sign-in help on explicit activation and preserve easy light-dismiss.

findings.summary: The teaching callout is an ad-hoc div/link overlay rather than a semantic popover.
findings.evidence: Recon found zero dialog, popover, or details elements while the visible teaching callout is represented by #smcTeachingCalloutPopover and a javascript:void(0) dismiss anchor.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the Popover API with a button invoker and declarative light-dismiss, retaining a robust fallback.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is viewport-based, with no component container queries detected.
findings.evidence: The page adapts at 360px without overflow, but the CSS probe found zero @container rules across reused card/navigation components.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container queries for reusable card and navigation components that appear in differently sized regions.

findings.summary: Cold-load LCP is outside the good Core Web Vitals range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.2s and FCP 3.0s; the CDP trace corroborated LCP/FCP at 2.22s under a separate run.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP path, shorten blocking CSS, and prioritize only the actual above-fold content.

findings.summary: Resource delivery is image-heavy and contains a long render-blocking chain.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 2.24MB across 68 requests, including 1.59MB images and eight parser-inserted high-priority stylesheets; Lighthouse estimated 940ms render-blocking and 1,632KiB cache-lifetime savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline or consolidate critical CSS, defer noncritical styles, set durable immutable caching for versioned assets, and lazy-load below-fold media.

findings.summary: The landing page ships avoidable duplicate JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse duplicated-javascript insight estimated 6KiB savings, alongside 14 scripts and 313KB transferred script bytes in the HAR.
findings.suggestedFix: Deduplicate shared modules and conditionally load support features only on templates that use them.

findings.summary: Focus order is manually reordered, and the search results template has no h1.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse and the focus probe found five positive tabindex values (1,2,4,5,6); search recon found zero h1 elements despite a full results page.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove positive tabindex values and follow DOM order; add a visible h1 such as “Search results for wifi”.

findings.summary: Images omit intrinsic dimensions and are delivered with poor responsive sizing.
findings.evidence: The image probe found all 46 images missing width/height, 12 missing srcset, eight oversized, and 46 legacy-format assets; Lighthouse also flagged 46 unsized and nine low-resolution images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width/height, responsive srcset/sizes, and appropriately encoded AVIF/WebP variants while preserving intentional presentation semantics.

findings.summary: A deprecated unload listener prevents back/forward cache restoration.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse traced an unload listener in the analytics bundle and reported BFCache failure UnloadHandlerExistsInMainFrame.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace unload handling with pagehide/visibilitychange and verify BFCache restoration.

findings.summary: Two controls are implemented as javascript:void(0) anchors, including the skip link.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse crawlable-anchors identified the skip-to-main and callout dismiss anchors; recon confirms the skip link href is javascript:void(0).
findings.suggestedFix: Use a real #supMainContent href for the skip link and a button for dismissal.

findings.summary: The representative article lacks structured entity metadata.
findings.evidence: Article metadata probe found zero JSON-LD blocks and no hreflang links, although the content has a canonical URL and localized site architecture.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Article JSON-LD, Open Graph/Twitter metadata, and hreflang links for localized equivalents.

findings.summary: The CSP only restricts framing and omits core XSS defenses.
findings.evidence: Headers show CSP 'frame-ancestors self' and HSTS, but no script/style/default-src policy, no X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP with default-src and script-src, add nosniff, strict referrer policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The anonymous landing load has a broad telemetry and cookie footprint.
findings.evidence: The tracker probe found seven third-party origins; HAR recorded 16 third-party requests and 181,561 bytes; Lighthouse found nine third-party cookies and the cookie probe found five SameSite=None cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit each telemetry/sign-in dependency, defer it until needed or consented, minimize identifiers, and partition or remove cross-site cookies where possible.

findings.summary: Localized pages remain heavily dependent on physical-direction CSS and expose no hreflang links.
findings.evidence: The article correctly declares en-US/ltr, but the stylesheet probe counted 263 physical-direction rules versus seven logical-property rules and no hreflang metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Migrate reusable layout rules to logical properties and publish hreflang alternates for translated articles.

findings.summary: Below-fold imagery is not optimized for transfer or viewport need.
findings.evidence: Images account for 1.59MB; 35 below-fold images are not lazy-loaded, all 46 are legacy PNG/JPG, 12 lack srcset, and eight are oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold media, generate responsive modern-format variants, and set a template-specific image budget.

findings.summary: The landing page eagerly fetches content and telemetry that is not needed in the first viewport.
findings.evidence: HAR totals 68 requests and 2.24MB while the first viewport is mostly headings and product links; 35 below-fold images load eagerly and telemetry contacts browser.events.data.microsoft.com.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer below-fold assets and nonessential telemetry until visibility, interaction, or idle time.

findings.summary: Third-party and image transfer is disproportionate to a text-first support landing page.
findings.evidence: Third parties transfer 181,561 bytes and images transfer 1.59MB on a page whose core task is navigating text links or searching.
findings.suggestedFix: Set enforceable third-party and media budgets, remove low-value dependencies, and defer sign-in/analytics bundles.

taskList.title: Restore natural keyboard and semantic navigation
Reduce anonymous telemetry and cookie scope
Remove unload/BFCache blocker and duplicate code
Replace auto-open custom callout with semantic popover
Improve article/search metadata and i18n structure
